reviews.title: A Beautiful Way to Beat the Heat!
reviews.comment: This AIO is as functional as it is beautiful! Not only is it a killer cooler for the price, it easily hangs with much more expensive options from more "mainstream" companies. It does an amazing job at keeping my 7800x3d running cool and efficiently. Even after hours long sessions playing Cyberpunk (High settings, no RT) and KCD2 (Ultra) at 1440p, the highest I've seen my CPU temp has been ~65° with an average of around 60°. As soon as I close the game, my temps drop back down to ~40° (idle temp) in no time at all. This cooler absolutely destroys heat, and I can't recommend it enough. The fans aren't dead quiet, but they definitely aren't loud by any means either. The blades on the fans are surprisingly thick, and the entire cooler is very well made. As a bonus, the fans have male and female connectors on the power wires as well as the aRGB wires, allowing effortless daisy chaining. The box includes AMD and Intel mounting hardware and some instructions that are pretty easy to follow. The AMD kit is labeled AM4, but it also works with AM5 perfectly. There are also videos made by the company on Amazon and YouTube that show how the pump and radiator should be mounted. Installation was super simple. The kit also includes a tube of thermal paste, but I opted for a tube of Arctic MX-4 (also purchased from Amazon for about $6). Overall, this AIO by ThermalRight is highly effective at an unbeatable price, and is a beautiful addition to any case. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Phillip

reviews.title: Stylish, Efficient, and the Perfect Gift – A Must-Have for White PC Builds!
reviews.comment: I recently purchased the Thermalright Frozen Infinity 240 White CPU Water Cooler as a Christmas gift for my daughter. She owns a CyberPowerPC acquired from eBay, equipped with an Intel i7-12700K processor. The stock air cooler was underperforming, with idle temperatures hovering around 50-60°C and even higher under load. This cooler has transformed her system's performance and appearance. Here's why it's a standout choice: 1. Elegant All-White Design with ARGB Lighting The all-white aesthetic of this cooler is truly eye-catching, aligning perfectly with the current trend of white-themed PC builds. The ARGB Infinity Mirror on the pump head adds a sophisticated touch, offering customizable lighting effects that enhance the overall visual appeal of her setup. Thermalright 2. Superior Cooling Efficiency Post-installation, the improvement in CPU temperatures was remarkable: Idle Temperatures: Dropped from 50-60°C to a cool 25-28°C. Under Load: Now maintains stable temperatures in the 50s°C, even during intensive gaming sessions. This significant reduction not only enhances performance but also contributes to the longevity of the CPU. 3. User-Friendly Installation Despite initial apprehensions about installing a liquid cooler, the process was straightforward. The package includes all necessary mounting hardware compatible with AMD AM4/AM5 and Intel LGA1150/1151/1200/2011/1700/1851 sockets. The clear instructions made the installation seamless, even for someone with moderate technical skills. Thermalright 4. Quiet and Efficient Operation Equipped with dual TL-M12W PWM fans operating at speeds up to 2000 RPM, the cooler delivers impressive airflow of 68.9 CFM while maintaining a low noise level of ≤28.2 dBA. This ensures a quiet computing environment, which is particularly appreciated during late-night gaming or streaming sessions. Thermalright 5. Excellent Value for Money Priced competitively, this cooler offers features and performance that rival higher-end models. Its combination of aesthetics, efficiency, and affordability makes it an outstanding choice for those looking to upgrade their cooling solutions without breaking the bank. In Summary: The Thermalright Frozen Infinity 240 White CPU Water Cooler has exceeded our expectations in both form and function. It has revitalized my daughter's PC, providing superior cooling performance and a modern, stylish look that aligns with current trends. For anyone considering an upgrade, especially for white-themed builds, this cooler is a stellar choice. Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Note: Always ensure compatibility with your system's specifications before installation.

reviews.title: Looks very premium for the price.
reviews.comment: Very affordable AIO that looks super premium. Arrives nicely packed and is super easy to install. It keeps my i7-14700f around 60 degrees under full load while still being super quite. You can not even hear the pump running. Definitely worth it if you need a cheap 360mm AIO that will successfully keep your CPU very cool.

reviews.title: Best AIO by far; can't be beat for the price
reviews.comment: I was in the market for a new AIO system because my previous AIO's pump fan had something wrong with it. It would constantly spin at 100% speed no matter what I changed in the bios or with software. That wouldn't typically bother me... except for the fact that the pump made an audible whirring noise that was very annoying. So that led me to this product. I did my research, and was a bit hesitant to buy this at first given that this is my first time buying one of Thermalright's products. Boy was I impressed! Idle temps are stupid low. I have a i7-12700k btw and as I'm typing this with like 5 programs in the background, I haven't seen it go over 27°C with a very low fan and pump speed curve. When gaming on Black Ops 6, surprisingly a relatively CPU intensive game, it barely touches 55°C. When encoding x264/x265 videos in HandBrake, it doesn't go above 60°C, and under a stress test, the highest I've seen is 65°C. The included fans are nice quality and quiet, and most importantly they can spin at really low RPMs which is nice, especially if you want to have quiet operation. The aRGB on both this and the waterblock look really nice and well saturated. A great quality product that works well, especially for the price! Will definitely be buying something from this brand in the future
